scenes.name: THE JET RING
lines: Sine, cosine and arctangent seem to demand the real line, endless series, and pi.
正弦、余弦与反正切，似乎非要实数轴、无穷级数和 π 不可。
A jet of order N is a row of N plus one rationals, and eta to the N plus one is zero.
N 阶射流就是一行 N + 1 个有理数，而 η 的 N + 1 次方等于零。
The derivative is a shift: slide each coefficient left, and multiply by its old index.
求导就是平移：每个系数左移一格，再乘以它原来的次数。

scenes.name: FOUR GENERATORS
lines: Four rows are fixed by rational coefficients: exponential, cosine, sine, arctangent.
四行射流由各自的有理系数唯一确定：指数、余弦、正弦与反正切。
Differentiate sine: the row slides into cosine. Differentiate cosine: minus sine.
对正弦求导，这一行滑成余弦；对余弦求导，得到负正弦。
Square cosine, square sine, and add: a one, then zeros all the way out to degree twelve.
余弦平方加正弦平方：先是一个 1，然后一路是 0，直到第 12 次。
Lean checks this Pythagorean identity at every degree, not just these twelve.
Lean 内核检验这条毕达哥拉斯恒等式在每一阶都成立，不止这 12 阶。

scenes.name: CAYLEY CIRCLE
lines: Now an algebra trick: send t to one minus t squared, and two t, each over one plus t squared.
再看一个初等代数技巧：把 t 送到 (1 − t²)/(1 + t²) 与 2t/(1 + t²)。
Feed it one half: a few multiplications, and we land on three fifths, four fifths, exactly.
代入 t = 1/2：几次乘法，精确落在 (3/5, 4/5)。
Lean checks, for any two integers not both zero, that the Cayley point lies on the unit circle.
Lean 内核检验：对任意不全为零的两个整数，凯莱点都落在单位圆上。

scenes.name: ONE AND THE SAME
lines: Compose the cosine row with twice the arctangent row.
把余弦这一行与两倍反正切这一行做形式复合。
Factorials and odd fractions cancel, and only plus and minus two survive.
阶乘与奇数分母彼此相消，只剩下 +2 与 −2。
That is exactly the Cayley fraction, expanded. Lean checks it for cosine and sine, at every order N.
这正是凯莱分式的展开。Lean 内核对余弦与正弦、对每个截断阶 N 都检验了它。
The series does not approximate the fraction. It slowly re-expands it.
不是级数在逼近这个分式，而是它在慢慢地把分式重新展开。

scenes.name: THE HALF AUDIT
lines: At one half, order two gives one half and one; order four, five eighths and three quarters.
Every two orders, both errors are multiplied by minus one quarter.
截断阶每加 2，两个误差都恰好乘以 −1/4。
At order twelve, the errors are still one over ten thousand two hundred forty, and minus one over five thousand one hundred twenty.

scenes.name: MACHIN'S CHAIN
lines: Now pi. Add tangents by a rational rule: u plus v, over one minus u v.
现在轮到 π。用有理法则做正切加法：(u + v)/(1 − uv)。
Start at one fifth. Double: five twelfths. Double again: one hundred twenty over one hundred nineteen.
Subtract one over two hundred thirty-nine: top and bottom both become twenty-eight thousand five hundred sixty-one.
再减去 1/239：分子与分母同为 28561。
That is thirteen to the fourth: the chain lands exactly on one, and Lean checks it. No pi, no arctangent.
28561 = 13⁴，整条链精确落到 1，Lean 内核已检验；全程无 π、无反正切。

scenes.name: PI-FREE BRACKETS
lines: Cut both alternating sums short, and Machin's weights give rational lower and upper ends.
把两条交替和截短，配上马青的权重，就得到有理的下端与上端。
At order one, the bracket runs from about three point one four zero six to three point one eight three three.
1 阶时，包络从约 3.1406 延伸到约 3.1833。
Each order shrinks it about twenty-five times; by order seventeen the width is about one point five seven times ten to the minus twenty-five.
每升一阶宽度约缩小 25 倍；到 17 阶，宽度约为 1.57 × 10⁻²⁵。
Only in the classical shadow is the point these brackets close in on called pi.
只有投到经典实分析的阴影里，这些区间收拢的那一点才被叫作 π。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: The differential half of calculus now lives over the rationals; next, integration without subdividing anything.
微积分的微分一翼已经落在有理数上；下一步是积分，而且不做任何细分。
Omega Math, chapter eight.
《OMEGA MATH》· 第八章
